patch_description:
The current program achieves 0.87 test accuracy but has a larger generalization gap (0.08) compared to prior programs (0.04-0.05). This suggests the ansatz lacks sufficient expressivity to learn generalizable features.

The current ANSATZ_SPEC uses:
- 8 RY gates (local rotations)
- 8 RZ gates (pre-entanglement)
- 4 CRY gates (even-pair entanglement, shared parameter)
- 3 CRZ gates (odd-pair entanglement, shared parameter)
- 8 RZ gates (post-entanglement)
Total: 18 unique parameters per block

This proposal adds:
1. Additional diagonal CZ gates connecting non-adjacent qubits (0-3, 1-4, 2-5, 3-6, 4-7) to create longer-range entanglement
2. An extra layer of RX rotations before the final RZ to increase local expressivity
3. More diverse entanglement patterns to capture complex feature interactions

This increases depth and gate count while keeping parameter count reasonable, targeting:
- Reduced generalization gap by better feature extraction
- Improved test accuracy toward 0.88+ by richer entanglement structure
- Better utilization of the fixed 3 uploads × 2 repeats structure
